title: ShapeComplexity: edge amount and macro-shape complexity of leaf outlines
description:
ShapeComplexity is a Rust tool (command line, GUI and library) that measures two properties of a leaf outline from an image mask. Edge amount (EA) is the extra length of the margin profile around a smoothed blade line; it grows with teeth. Macro-shape complexity (MC) sums the log excess of elliptic Fourier fitting errors of the whitened blade line over a tolerance; it grows with lobes. It also reports blade elongation and petiole length.

Version 2.0.0 replaces the entropy-based metrics of version 1.0.0. It accompanies the manuscript "Separating teeth from lobes in leaf outlines: edge amount and macro-shape complexity" (in preparation).
